title: Geometric stalks commute with derived tensor against a constant module
statement: For any scheme X, commutative coefficient ring R, geometric point x of X, derived etale module complex L and R-module N, the exact derived geometric stalk of L tensor^L constant(N)[0] is isomorphic in D(R) to the derived stalk of L tensor^L N[0]. No boundedness, finiteness or Noetherian assumption is required.

source.place: Proof of Tag 09BI, using Tags 03PT and 07A4

proof.text:
Proof. Apply the existing unbounded derived tensor/stalk comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.exists_derivedTensor_stalk_iso` to L and the degree-zero
constant sheaf of N. It gives an isomorphism from the stalk of the derived tensor
to the tensor of the two derived stalks. The exact-functor comparison
`mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor` identifies the second stalk with the degree-zero
complex on the ordinary stalk of the constant sheaf, and
`sheafFiberConstantSheafIso` identifies that ordinary stalk with N. Tensoring this
last composite on the left by the derived stalk of L gives the displayed isomorphism.
The cited comparison is unbounded and has no finiteness, boundedness, or
Noetherian hypotheses, so the edge cases of zero rings and zero modules are included.

theorem geometricStalk_tensor_constant_single
    (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (L : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) :
    let F := (pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)
    letI : F.Additive := (pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber_additive
    Nonempty
      (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) X).obj L).obj
            ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)).obj N))) ≅
        F.mapDerivedCategory.obj L ⊗
          (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) 0).obj N)
